name: @activepieces/piece-subflows
description: Trigger and call another sub flow.

callFlow.name: callFlow
callFlow.description: Call a flow that has "Callable Flow" trigger

flowId.description: The flow to execute. Published flows with a "Callable Flow" trigger appear here; disabled flows are marked "(inactive)" and cannot be executed until they are enabled.

mode.description: Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced for JSON.

streamCsvToSubflows.name: streamCsvToSubflows
streamCsvToSubflows.description: Stream a CSV and call a subflow once per batch of rows, without loading the whole file into memory.

file.description: The CSV to stream. Accepts a URL, an uploaded file, or a file from a previous step. It is streamed, not loaded into memory.

subflow.description: The subflow to call for each batch. Published flows with a "Callable Flow" trigger appear here; disabled flows are marked "(inactive)".

batchSize.description: How many CSV rows to send in each subflow call. Between 1 and 10000.

extraData.description: Optional data sent to every subflow call alongside the batch rows. Reference the output of a previous step.

returnResponse.name: returnResponse
returnResponse.description: Return response to the original flow

mode.description: Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced for JSON.

callableFlow.name: callableFlow
callableFlow.description: Waiting to be triggered from another flow

mode.description: Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced for JSON.

exampleData.description: The schema to be passed to the flow

Trigger en bel een andere sub-stroom.
nl.Call a flow that has \"Callable Flow\" t: Bel een stroom aan die "Callable Flow" trigger heeft
nl.Return response to the original flow: Retourneer reactie op de originele stroom
nl.The flow to execute. Only published flow: De stroom om uit te voeren. Alleen gepubliceerde flows met een "Callable Flow" trigger verschijnen hier — ongepubliceerde of uitgeschakelde substromen worden verborgen.
nl.Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced: Kies Simpel voor sleutelwaarde of Geavanceerd voor JSON.
nl.Waiting to be triggered from another flo: Wachten om geactiveerd te worden via een andere stroom
nl.The schema to be passed to the flow: Het schema dat aan de stroom moet worden doorgegeven

Trigger und rufen Sie einen anderen Subfluss.
de.Call a flow that has \"Callable Flow\" t: Rufe einen Fluss auf, der "Callable Flow" auslöst
de.Return response to the original flow: Zurück zur Antwort auf den ursprünglichen Fluss
de.The flow to execute. Only published flow: Der auszuführende Strömung. Nur veröffentlichte Ströme mit einem "Callable Flow" Trigger erscheinen hier — unveröffentlichte oder deaktivierte Subflows werden ausgeblendet.
de.Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced: Wählen Sie Einfache für den Schlüsselwert oder Erweitert für JSON.
de.Waiting to be triggered from another flo: Warte auf Auslösung von einem anderen Fluss
de.The schema to be passed to the flow: Das Schema, das an den Fluss übergeben werden soll

Déclenchez et appelez un autre sous-flux.
fr.Call a flow that has \"Callable Flow\" t: Appeler un flux qui a le déclencheur "Callable Flow"
fr.Return response to the original flow: Renvoyer la réponse au flux d'origine
fr.The flow to execute. Only published flow: Le flux à exécuter. Seuls les flux publiés avec un déclencheur « Callable Flow» apparaissent ici — les sous-flux non publiés ou désactivés sont cachés.
fr.Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced: Choisissez Simple pour la valeur de la clé ou Advanced pour JSON.
fr.Waiting to be triggered from another flo: En attente d'être déclenchée à partir d'un autre flux
fr.The schema to be passed to the flow: Le schéma à passer au flux

Activa y llama a otro sub-flujo.
es.Call a flow that has \"Callable Flow\" t: Llamar a un flujo que tiene activado "flujo llamable"
es.Return response to the original flow: Devuelve la respuesta al flujo original
es.The flow to execute. Only published flow: El flujo a ejecutar. Sólo los flujos publicados con un disparador de "flujo llamable" aparecen aquí — los subflujos no publicados o desactivados están ocultos.
es.Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced: Elija Simple para el valor de clave o avanzado para JSON.
es.Waiting to be triggered from another flo: Esperando a ser activado desde otro flujo
es.The schema to be passed to the flow: El esquema a pasar al flujo

別のサブフローをトリガーして呼び出します。
ja.Call a flow that has \"Callable Flow\" t: "Callable Flow" トリガーがあるフローを呼び出します。
ja.Return response to the original flow: 元のフローに返信する
ja.The flow to execute. Only published flow: 実行するフロー。"Callable Flow" トリガーを持つ公開されたフローのみがここに表示されます — 非公開または無効化されたサブフローは非表示になります。
ja.Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced: JSONの場合は「単純」、または「高度」を選択します。
ja.Callable Flow: 呼び出し可能なフロー
ja.Waiting to be triggered from another flo: 別のフローからのトリガーを待機しています
ja.The schema to be passed to the flow: フローに渡されるスキーマ

Disparar e chamar outro sub fluxo.
pt.Call a flow that has \"Callable Flow\" t: Chamar um fluxo com o gatilho "Flow Callable"
pt.Return response to the original flow: Retornar a resposta ao fluxo original
pt.The flow to execute. Only published flow: O fluxo a ser executado. Somente fluxos publicados com um gatilho "Callable Flow" aparecem aqui — não publicado ou desabilitado subflows estão ocultos.
pt.Choose Simple for key-value or Advanced: Escolha Simples para o valor-chave ou Avançado para JSON.
pt.Waiting to be triggered from another flo: Esperando para ser acionado de outro fluxo
pt.The schema to be passed to the flow: O esquema a ser passado ao fluxo
